name: Troyas' Stave
summary: Troyas' Stave may be the key to the Equinex Monolith in the Ruins of Ravenwind. Four lingering flames hold the power needed to test it.

sections.title: The Four Flames
sections.body: Among the Ruins of Ravenwind in Feralas, Troyas' Stave is meant for the Equinex Monolith. The four flames Samha, Imbel, Byltan, and Lahassa still burn nearby, each holding an essence. Gather them, then use their power beside the monolith to energize the stave.

sections.title: The Monolith
sections.body: When the energized stave touches the cold face of the Equinex Monolith, a small door opens. Within lies a sacred artifact, and beams of light fill the ruins around the stone.

faq.answer: Troyas' Stave is meant to unlock the Equinex Monolith in the Ruins of Ravenwind.
The Equinex Monolith stands in the Ruins of Ravenwind, in Feralas west of the Dream Bough.

faq.q: How do I energize Troyas' Stave?
faq.answer: Recover the essences of Samha, Imbel, Byltan, and Lahassa, then use them beside the Equinex Monolith.

faq.q: What are the four flames called?
faq.answer: The four flames are Samha, Imbel, Byltan, and Lahassa.

faq.q: What is inside the Equinex Monolith?
faq.answer: A sacred artifact rests inside the Equinex Monolith.
